prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing realistic mentoring photo used inside the STAŻ card on a developer portfolio.
Edit target: supplied photo. Change ONLY the marker drawing and writing on the whiteboard at the right. Keep both people, their exact faces, clothing, body positions, hands, marker, laptop, table, office, lighting, color grading, framing and camera perspective unchanged.
Primary request: replace the empty boxes on the whiteboard with a believable, clearly labeled software application architecture sketch that a mentor would actually explain. The board should have a small handwritten heading WEB APP. Preserve the current connected box layout and make its contents meaningful: top box UI, central box API, left box Auth, right database cylinder DB, lower box Tests. The mentor's marker should point at the central API box as before. Use crisp dark blue marker letters, legible large short words centered inside the shapes. Connect UI down to API, Auth to API, API to DB and Tests to API with normal simple arrows. Add a small realistic endpoint annotation GET /users beneath the diagram. The drawing should feel like an informal genuine engineering discussion, with tidy marker strokes and correct perspective on the board.
Text (verbatim): WEB APP, UI, API, Auth, DB, Tests, GET /users.
Constraints: edit only the board content. No empty unlabeled squares, no gibberish words, no decorative futuristic diagram, no new people or objects, no additional title or UI outside the whiteboard. Preserve all original photographic details and lighting.
